probe.proof:
by
  intro h
  let p : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ := fun n => Nat.rec (1, 2) (fun _ x => (x.2, 4 * x.2 - x.1)) n
  let a : ℕ → ℤ := fun n => (p n).1
  have hp (n : ℕ) : p (n + 1) = ((p n).2, 4 * (p n).2 - (p n).1) := by simp [p]
  have hs (n : ℕ) : a (n + 1) = (p n).2 := by simp [a, hp]
  have hr (n : ℕ) : a (n + 2) = 4 * a (n + 1) - a n := by
    calc
      a (n + 2) = (p (n + 1)).2 := by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hs (n + 1)
      _ = 4 * (p n).2 - (p n).1 := by rw [hp]
      _ = 4 * a (n + 1) - a n := by rw [hs]; rfl
  have hab : a 0 = 1 ∧ a 1 = 2 := by constructor <;> norm_num [a, p]
  have hre : ∀ n ≥ 2, a n = 4 * a (n - 1) - a (n - 2) := by
    intro n hn
    have h₂ : n - 2 + 2 = n := by omega
    have h₁ : n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 := by omega
    simpa only [h₂, h₁] using hr (n - 2)
  have ho : Odd putnam_2015_a2_solution := (h a hab hre).1
  exact (show ¬ Odd putnam_2015_a2_solution by decide) ho
